verdict.rationale: Veriff offers PEP & Sanctions plus adverse media/ongoing monitoring checks as part of the same platform, with a dedicated watchlist-screening webhook returning combined results, and it's priced as an add-on within the same API/portal (pricing, webhook docs). Review of these results happens in the same Customer Portal used for identity verification, giving one vendor/one review surface. Missing for 10: explicit documentation showing PEP/sanctions data surfaced in the same decision object/API response alongside identity verdicts, and independent/hands-on confirmation of combined review UX.
